blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Bureau of Corrections (BuCor) on Friday said it is reviewing the food allocation and its nutritional content of persons deprived of liberty (PDLs) in the Zamboanga prison facility following a sudden rise in deaths possibly linked to thiamine deficiency. Based on initial findings submitted on Thursday to Director General Pio Catapang Jr., BuCor said that deaths among infirmary patients at the San Ramon Prison and Penal Farm rose from eight in September to 25 this month.
